about: South Huron is a municipality in Huron County, Ontario, centred on Exeter—not a city, and not Grand Bend (in neighbouring Lambton Shores). Villages, farmland, and former air-station country at Centralia and Huron Park share a rich agricultural landscape inland from Lake Huron. About 10,000 people live in South Huron.
